feature: AdminV2 Risk-Based Decisions module + linked-check picker (accepted-risk alert suppression, Git #1294)
notes: SCOPE (decision REVERSED from the earlier #1294 attempt): #1279 added msp_risk_decisions.check_key
(nullable, suppresses accepted-risk alert re-firing) but left it settable only via a raw POST body field.
The first #1294 attempt put the picker in the msp-portal RiskBasedDecisionConsole; Shane reopened and
decided (issue comment 2026-08-26): there is NO MSP-operator audience this version, so RBD management moves
to a NEW PlatformAdmin-only AdminV2 module, and the msp-portal console leaves the live app with #1297. This
manifest was retargeted from that removed console to the new AdminV2 surface accordingly.
WHAT WAS BUILT: new admin-scoped API routes/admin-rbd.ts (requireAdmin / PlatformAdmin): GET
/api/admin/rbd/entry/:id -- scoped by resolveTenantScope(customerId) exactly like admin-retainer.ts. The
linked-check <select> reuses the existing GET /api/msp/rbd/available-checks (unchanged). New AdminV2 screen
form's picker; rbd-relink-picker on the peek's re-link panel).
AUTH / RUNNABILITY: the headless harness cannot mint a PlatformAdmin session cookie, so the apiTests below
prove the auth walls are intact rather than exercising a real create (same honesty convention as
test-manifests/admin/testbed-gate-negative.json). The available-checks 401 assertion is the same one the
prior #1294 session already ran green. The AdminV2 UI (a real PlatformAdmin browser session driving the
picker end-to-end) is a SHANE TO-DO: it needs a platform-admin login the harness has no way to synthesise.
